remaining_w2_method: At elapsed=0: calibration residuals. After waiting begins: ESI-stratified calibration analogs conditioned on observed W2 > elapsed and matched on base total-W2 prediction.
remaining_w2_selection_bias_warning: Calibration uses patients with observed room entry. LWBS censoring can bias the conditional remaining-time distribution. This is a simplified prototype, not a survival model.
lwbs_model_scope: Static offline post-triage risk analysis; not updated from elapsed waiting time.
clinical_warning: Prototype only. ESI and clinical priority always remain clinician-controlled.
